text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: I've been dealing with this persistent dry cough and shortness of breath for about two weeks. It definitely gets much worse when I try to exert myself or when I lie down at night.
